name: Elena Millionaire
original_name: エレナ ミリオネア
source:
A cheerful, busty, and straightforward college student. She says she came to this hot spring town because she was drawn to the mysterious tales associated with the area and the enigmatic writings found at Inamori Shrine and other sites.

She took a liking to Kazuki after he showed her around the area, and she makes a point of paying him attention every time they meet.

[From [url=https://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/premiumbox/soft/boin/]official site[/url]]
